title: Concept: Deleted record counter returned in stats
description: A deleted counter beside the live counter in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The counter states how much data the bank keeps after deletion, which is a retention fact that contradicts the customer-facing promise.
applicability: Deployments that render a deleted counter beside the live counter into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The counter states how much data the bank keeps after deletion, which is a retention fact that contradicts the customer-facing promise.
